name: portal-relay
description: Deploy, verify, and register a self-hosted Portal relay, on any Linux host or through Oracle Cloud, Hetzner Cloud, and Cloudflare DNS.

interface.longDescription: Deploy a public Portal relay with Docker Compose, delegate its DNS zone to the embedded authoritative DNS server, optionally enable TCP/UDP lease ports for game hosting, verify health and tunnel egress, and register the relay in the public pool.
defaultPrompt: Run a public Portal relay on this server and verify its health endpoint.
Set up a Portal relay with TCP/UDP leases for game hosting.
Register my Portal relay in the public relay pool.
Deploy a Portal relay on Oracle Cloud and configure DNS with Cloudflare.
